messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Neon Pairs is implemented, including board codes, snapshot import and export, and the replay command. Open the single-file offline game at [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html).

The locked install, typecheck, unit tests, build, and eight browser journeys passed. The browser checks covered offline play, keyboard and accessibility-tree behavior, saved preferences, snapshot resume, timer handling, and large-board layouts. The replay command was also checked with valid and invalid input.

No screen reader or real-device touch long press was used; those remain user acceptance checks.
